verdict.rationale: Calendly ships an official MCP server that explicitly translates natural-language commands (e.g., 'Book a 30-minute meeting with Sam next Tuesday') into structured API calls, and a live runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is reachable and speaks the OAuth/DCR flow as documented. Calendly also offers 'Callie,' an AI assistant that schedules via natural-language email threads, reinforcing NL-driven operation beyond just MCP tool calls. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation that NL commands via MCP or Callie reliably produce correct bookings in practice (community evidence only covers manual scheduling UX, not AI/NL usage).
